script_text: Stop, Taurus, the cosmos is igniting a fierce and undeniable battle in your personal arena! Mars is rapidly sprinting through your 10th House of Career in Aquarius, forming a tense square to your ruling planet Venus in your 4th House of Home in Leo. This Earth element friction forces your ambitious professional goals to violently collide with your domestic comfort zone right now. If you are taken, this friction threatens to spill heavy workplace stress directly into your partnership, requiring immense patience; if single, a captivating but unstable figure enters your life. Expect a sudden financial pivot in your 10th House sector, as a delayed promotion finally clears the air, but you must fiercely defend your newly acquired boundaries at all costs. Avoid signing any contracts today, as a hidden clause threatens to completely reverse your recent professional progress. Follow for tomorrow's reading to see how this intense planetary energy resolves.
